title: The Last Hollow Again
author: Mara Quintana
blurb: Quentin Blackwood, a thief who steals memories, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
